questions.statement: How many fingers do you have on one hand?
questions.context: Learning about review period 1 in English class.

options.feedback: Correct. One hand has five fingers: thumb, index, middle, ring and little.
Each finger has one fingernail, but a whole hand has five fingers, so one is too few.
Ten is the number of fingers on both hands together, and the question asks about one hand only.
A hand always has its fingers; zero would mean a hand with no fingers at all.

questions.statement: Where do you put your pencil?
questions.context: Learning about review period 1 in English class.

options.feedback: Under the bed is where a lost object may fall, but a pencil is kept in a pencil case.
The trash is for things you throw away, and a pencil is still useful.
Correct. A pencil case is made to hold pencils and keeps them from rolling away or breaking.
A fridge keeps food cold; a pencil would be ruined inside it.
